findings.summary: Native prefix budget can exceed SDK aggregate input admission
findings.detail: Witnessed native estimate charges (body fields + 23 header fields + 30 proof fields)*69 + 640 per block; SDK snapshot charges the same field count*69 + 2048. A page near native 2MiB may be rejected before SDK authentication, and the same unchanged cursor/request repeats without progress. Illustrative 100-field bodies: native11197 bytes versus SDK12605 per block;187 blocks fit native budget but exceed SDK budget. Exact valid protocol-body regression should be retained by implementer.
findings.requiredRepair: Conservatively bound native selected prefix using the downstream SDK admission budget as well as wire budget; preserve2MiB and stop before flattening the next block.
